# Fix Broken LinkedIn URLs

> Recover the current LinkedIn profile from an old, stale, or broken URL. The response is a live profile. No match, no charge.

Mawsool publishes this as an Apify Actor. Send the LinkedIn URL you already stored, even if it 404s. A hit returns the current URL, headline, company, title, experience, and education, fetched at run time. A miss is free.

## Run

- Apify Actor: https://apify.com/oday/mawsool-fix-broken-linkedin-urls
- Call: `oday/mawsool-fix-broken-linkedin-urls`
- API key: https://mawsool.tech/ and https://docs.mawsool.tech/
- Contact: osama@mawsool.tech, info@mawsool.tech

## Result

- Live profile: exact or confident. Safe to replace the stored URL.
- Review this match: likely. A person checks the name, company, and title first.
- No match, free: nothing found. Not charged.

## Price

Starting from $1 per 1,000 live profiles on Apify. Gold, Platinum, and Diamond are $1. The free plan is $1.80. Misses are free.

## Use it when

The URL is old. A name change, a certificate added to the name, or a custom-link edit replaced the slug. The person is often still on LinkedIn.

## Use something else when

- The URL already opens and you only need the current company and headline: https://apify.com/oday/mawsool-linkedin-profile-freshness
- You stored the old company and want a comparison: https://apify.com/oday/mawsool-linkedin-company-checker
- The URL already opens and you want a full scrape: https://apify.com/oday/mawsool-linkedin-profile-details
